name: PillNav-TS-TW
blurb: Pill nav buttons with a spring circle and swapping text labels.
description: Navigation with pill-shaped buttons that animate on hover. A circle expands beneath the text, which moves to reveal a secondary label in a different color. GSAP-powered.
use_when: Modern site nav requiring premium micro-interactions and responsive design.
avoid_when: When you need lightweight, static navigation — adds GSAP dependency and animation overhead.
a11y: Semantic nav with menubar/menuitem roles and keyboard navigation. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
